## Classic Pumpkin Pie

Quintessential Thanksgiving — nothing beats it for tradition.

**Crust**
- 1 pre-made pie crust or 1.5 cups flour, 1/2 cup cold butter, 4 tbsp ice water for homemade

**Filling**
- 1 can (15 oz) pumpkin puree
- 3/4 cup brown sugar
- 1 tsp cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground ginger
- 1/4 tsp ground cloves
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 3 large eggs
- 1 can (12 oz) evaporated milk

**Method**
Line a 9-inch pie pan with the crust. Whisk all filling ingredients until smooth. Pour into the crust. Bake at 425F for 15 minutes, then reduce to 350F for another 35-40 minutes until just barely set in the center. Cool completely before slicing. Serve with whipped cream.
